hypothesis: Wire estimate-revision outcome catch-up into the daily settlement pipeline so recent pending ledgers are automatically re-settled when the hot OHLCV warehouse advances, instead of spending new experiment IDs on hand materialization.
new_evidence_axis: Pipeline wiring, not a new alpha gate: recent prior estimate-revision ledgers are re-settled automatically as the hot warehouse advances.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The helper already knew how to roll a weekend requested entry date to the first available trading bar, but the daily pipeline only settled today's ledger. Adding recent-ledger catch-up lets matured prior rows settle automatically as OHLCV advances.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not reserve further IDs to hand-refresh estimate-revision outcomes for each new warehouse day. Routine prior-ledger settlement is now run.py plumbing.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Alpha-compliant revision work still needs H3/H5/H10 closed replacement rows with cash/SPY/QQQ comparators, materially more non-flat matched rows, or a distinct unsaturated PIT expectation source.
